bull.point: The company maintains a robust balance sheet with virtually no debt and high capital efficiency.
Revenue growth has accelerated significantly in recent quarters, reaching high double-digit year-on-year increases.
bull.evidence: Jun 2026 revenue grew 36.0% and Sep 2026 grew 26.0% YoY

bull.point: Cash generation remains exceptionally strong relative to reported earnings over the long term.
bull.evidence: 124% of reported profit turned into operating cash over 6 years

bear.point: Operating profit margins have seen a sharp decline compared to the previous year's performance.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 9% vs 12% a year ago

bear.point: Net profit is trending downward despite rising revenues, indicating significant cost pressures.
bear.evidence: Sep 2026 PAT fell to 2466.0 from 3349.0 in Sep 2025

bear.point: Operating margin percentage has hit a multi-quarter low in the most recent periods.
bear.evidence: OPM % dropped to 8.0 in Jun 2026 and 9.0 in Sep 2026

watch_next: Recovery of OPM % toward the 12-13% historical annual average
Stabilization of PAT following the drop to 2466.0 Cr in Sep 2026
Sustainability of 20%+ revenue growth seen in the last three quarters
